shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 & sleep 4 echo "=== initial page ===" curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '[^<]+' | head -5 echo "=== server log ===" cat /tmp/next-start.log | tail -5

cd /workspace && (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 5 ; echo "=== initial page ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '[^<]+' | head -5 ; echo "=== server log ===" ; tail -5 /tmp/next-start.log

cd /workspace && echo "=== initial posts on page ===" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '[^<]+' && echo "=== action id ===" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '"[0-9a-f]{40}"' | head -1 && echo "=== action id (alt) ===" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[0-9a-f]+' | head -1

cd /workspace && echo "=== POST to Server Action ===" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3123/ \ -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data" \ -H "Next-Action: 40e0bdf0f55f3d8aab68e02b1b1a3fd2d126fb6322" \ -F "1_title=My New Post" \ -F "0=[\"My New Post\",\"Second post body\"]" \ -o /tmp/action-resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" ; echo "=== response head ===" ; head -c 300 /tmp/action-resp.txt ; echo ; echo "=== page after action ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '[^<]+'

cd /workspace && echo "=== POST to Server Action (form fields) ===" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3123/ \ -H "Next-Action: 40e0bdf0f55f3d8aab68e02b1b1a3fd2d126fb6322" \ -F "title=My New Post" \ -F "content=Second post body" \ -o /tmp/action-resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" ; echo "=== response head ===" ; head -c 400 /tmp/action-resp.txt ; echo ; echo "=== page after action ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '[^<]+'

cd /workspace && grep -rl "createPost" .next/server/app/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; grep -rn "a.get is not a function\|\.get(" .next/server/chunks/ssr/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "formdata\|get(" | head -5

cd /workspace && echo "=== POST with RSC + multipart, plain fields ===" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3123/ \
  -H "Next-Action: 40e0bdf0f55f3d8aab68e02b1b1a3fd2d126fb6322" \
  -H "Accept: text/x-component" \
  -F "title=My New Post" \
  -F "content=Second post body" \
  -o /tmp/action-resp.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" ; echo "=== response head ===" ; head -c 400 /tmp/action-resp.txt ; echo ; echo "=== server log tail ===" ; tail -8 /tmp/next-start.log

cd /workspace && echo "=== POST as non-JS form ===" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3123/ \ -F '$ACTION_ID_40e0bdf0f55f3d8aab68e02b1b1a3fd2d126fb6322=' \ -F 'title=My New Post' \ -F 'content=Second post body' \ -o /tmp/action-resp.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" ; echo "=== response: post titles ===" ; grep -oE '[^<]+' /tmp/action-resp.html ; echo "=== server log tail ===" ; tail -8 /tmp/next-start.log
cd /workspace && echo "=== fresh GET after action ===" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '[^<]+'
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "server stopped"
